prompt:
Answer the question using ONLY the documentation excerpt below. DOCUMENTATION EXCERPT (from ModelRig's public probe-suite docs):
"The probe harness samples each fixture several times and stops the moment accrued spend crosses the per-run envelope, whose default is 5 US dollars per model. Every published leaderboard row ships with its raw samples, so you can reproduce any number by running the same suite with your own API key."

QUESTION: What is the default per-run probe envelope, in US dollars per model?
